items.t: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on MSCI Stock?
items.sum: Despite MSCI’s outperformance relative to the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts remain highly bullish on the stock’s future prospects.

items.t: MSCI considers alternatives to Indonesia downgrade after Prabowo talks
items.sum: Investing.com -- MSCI is considering alternatives to a threatened downgrade of Indonesia’s stock-market classification following direct discussions between its chief executive and President Prabowo Subianto, Bloomberg News reported on Monday.
